entry_trigger: survivor intake, assessment, shelter roster, field outreach, or community report
critical_handoffs: case manager; housing lead; health lead; school liaison; benefits agency; legal aid
no_drop_rule: referral must be accepted or logged as unresolved need

entry_trigger: shelter, hotel, temporary unit, unsafe return, or repair denial
critical_handoffs: safe refuge; building safety; property proof; repair market; rental assistance; CDBG-DR or local housing recovery
no_drop_rule: temporary placement must have review date and exit destination class

entry_trigger: child displaced, school closed, address lost, records missing, or transport disrupted
critical_handoffs: homeless education liaison; transport; meal service; childcare; disability support
no_drop_rule: student enrolled or school-origin/best-interest decision made without document barrier

entry_trigger: medically dependent person displaced, shelter intake, outage, pharmacy closure, dialysis disruption
critical_handoffs: public health; pharmacy; dialysis; oxygen/DME supplier; transport; power/charging; payer
no_drop_rule: patient has medicine/device/care/referral path before discharge or shelter exit

entry_trigger: food loss, income loss, shelter roster, retailer disruption, or school meal disruption
critical_handoffs: commodities; D-SNAP; replacement benefits; retailers; school meals; WIC/formula; special diets
no_drop_rule: food is reachable, usable, and repeatable on next cycle

entry_trigger: disaster-related arrears, shutoff notice, return-ready home without service, medical baseline need
critical_handoffs: utility; regulator; LIHEAP/energy aid; water CAP; case manager; consumer advocate
no_drop_rule: service not disconnected where life/safe return depends on it without review and appeal

entry_trigger: missed filing, appeal, hearing, renewal, tax, claim, aid, or utility deadline during disaster
critical_handoffs: courts; agencies; tax authority; legal aid; insurer; assistance programme
no_drop_rule: disaster-caused missed deadline has toll, extension, late filing, or reopen path

entry_trigger: multiple programmes, duplicate proof, unresolved need, denial, or appeal
critical_handoffs: case manager; FEMA/national aid; insurer; local aid; philanthropy; legal aid; CDBG-DR
no_drop_rule: survivor not required to navigate sequencing alone

entry_trigger: case closed, assistance awarded, or household moved from intake
critical_handoffs: case manager; recovery coordinator; public dashboard owner; community partner
no_drop_rule: closure must show functional outcome or unresolved need with reopen path

entry_trigger: missed payments, debt collection, credit damage, asset sale, or delayed insurance/aid
critical_handoffs: lender/servicer; consumer finance lead; insurer; legal aid; case manager
no_drop_rule: aid delay must not become credit damage, predatory debt, or asset loss without review

entry_trigger: renter displaced, lease disrupted, rent rises, or unit repaired without return path
critical_handoffs: housing lead; fair housing office; legal aid; landlord; tenant organization
no_drop_rule: public housing recovery must include tenant notice, affordability, return, and appeal

entry_trigger: employment or self-employment interrupted by disaster
critical_handoffs: labor agency; employer; workforce board; benefits agency; worker center
no_drop_rule: income support must connect to safe reemployment and household service floors

critical_handoffs: transport agency; paratransit; case manager; school/health transport
no_drop_rule: recovery-critical trips must be served or the service must move to the household

entry_trigger: safe structure lacks appliances, devices, assistive tech, DME, or basic contents
critical_handoffs: IA lead; disability service; insurer; voluntary agencies
no_drop_rule: safe return requires functional items or safe substitutes, not merely structural repair

entry_trigger: lost documents, phone, account, or MFA blocks applications/status/appeals
critical_handoffs: identity provider; telecom; benefits agency; legal aid; case manager
no_drop_rule: no essential recovery step may be online-only or single-authenticator-only

entry_trigger: programme attempts to close while residual risk or unresolved needs remain
critical_handoffs: recovery coordinator; mitigation officer; finance officer; public auditor
no_drop_rule: closeout must transfer residual risk and lessons to named owners, budgets, standards, or reopen rules
